summary: Star Fashion Culture Holdings filed a 6-K disclosing a registered best-efforts follow-on equity offering of up to 12,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.80 per share, or up to roughly $9.6 million gross. The F-1 (No. 333-298981) was declared effective September 24, 2026. Kingswood Capital Partners acted as placement agent, earning a 6.5% cash fee plus 0.6% non-accountable expense reimbursement. Proceeds fund online marketing services, general administration, and working capital. The Cayman-based Nasdaq issuer relied on the foreign-private-issuer home-country exemption, bypassing Nasdaq shareholder approval rules. Watch dilution overhang and pricing pressure.
